about: The cadence a tracked charge's dates fall in (recurring.cadence_of): of the gaps between them, at least SHARE within GAP_TOLERANCE of one cadence, the shortest first. Python (tests/test_subscriptions.py) and the views' preview (web/test/shape.test.ts, chargeCadence) both check these. Made-up dates.

cases.why: monthly with one extra purchase in between: under 70% of gaps on time
monthly, the extra purchase taken out: monthly again
a few days late each time, within 20% of a month
out of order: read by date
